# `ScopeGoto`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mount slew worker state (guider slew, or the imager's nested goto parent).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider SlewToCoordinatesAsync @0xf52a0, PrintCloseState @0xed920; imager callbacks @0x16c790, @0x18cf30 (64-bit builds); 32-bit counterparts present |

F family, two producers. (1) The guider (TCP 4400) names its slew worker ScopeGoto when scope_goto starts an asynchronous slew; its callback may add close. The imager forwards guider event lines unchanged to TCP 4700 (the auxiliary imager process does not forward guider events). (2) The imager itself creates a nested ScopeGoto function under AutoGoto and wide-mosaic operations; its callbacks add cur_ra_dec and dist_deg. These additions are not on every event. Both reach every retained 4700 socket; the guider copy also goes to 4400 clients. The movement watcher handles the terminal state and may switch tracking on, so a ScopeTrack event can follow. Order relative to the scope_goto reply is not established. F errors describe the slew, not a guide frame. APK consumers: the legacy scope-goto handler and the app-state goto handler.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"ScopeGoto"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | F state table: idle 0, working 1, complete 2, fail 3, cancel 4; an unknown internal code falls back to idle. A formatter's supported state is not a promise that every run visits it. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if a non-empty stage string is held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if state is working, or the timer was started (terminal states) | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or started with no end) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Ordered function-tree ancestry when included; a missing route is a legitimate branch. Not an address. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Message for code; written for state fail even when the stored code is zero. Lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'. Cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Written for state fail, including a stored zero. Cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `cur_ra_dec` | array<number> | if imager producer, coordinates valid | - | Current mount coordinates. Imager producer only (nested ScopeGoto under AutoGoto or wide mosaic), under that callback's cached/query validity branch. Coordinate units are producer-specific. Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |
| `dist_deg` | number | if imager producer | - | Distance to target. Imager producer only. Degrees is inferred. [READ; unit INFERRED (degrees)] |
| `close` | boolean | if guider producer and the mount query returns false | - | Guider producer only. Written when the non-null mount query returns false; the value comes from comparing a returned number with a compiled negative threshold, whose physical meaning is unresolved. The true-result branch omits it. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, imager-working - Imager nested goto in progress (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"ScopeGoto","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":4200,"route":["View","AutoGoto"],"cur_ra_dec":[5.5,20.0],"dist_deg":12.5}
```

Event, guider-complete - Guider slew finished (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"ScopeGoto","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":18000,"close":false}
```

Event, fail - Slew failed (READ shape; message invented):

```json
{"Event":"ScopeGoto","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","lapse_ms":900,"error":"fail to operate","code":0}
```
